name: verdure-functions
description: Server-authoritative game logic + notifications for Verdure

scripts.e2e: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "node functions/scripts/e2e-backend.mjs"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.redteam: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "node functions/scripts/redteam.mjs"
scripts.test:units: npm run check:classifier && npm run build && node scripts/fulfillment-unit.mjs && node scripts/subscription-unit.mjs && node scripts/ingest-unit.mjs && node scripts/ranking-unit.mjs && node scripts/notifications-unit.mjs && node scripts/partners-unit.mjs && node scripts/event-planner-unit.mjs && node scripts/parks-unit.mjs && node scripts/offline-unit.mjs
scripts.seed:partners: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore "node functions/scripts/seed-partners.mjs"
scripts.coverage:emulator: cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore "node functions/scripts/coverage-check.mjs"
scripts.corpus:local: npm run build && cd .. && npx firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore "node functions/scripts/local-corpus-gate.mjs"
